svg.text: Bayu Relay · Bayu Core connector map, phase 1
One Core board for every variant, 60 × 40 mm at 12 px per mm. Grey parts are not fitted on Relay.
Nets, the same colour on every sheet
On the Relay: U2 and J3 SHT40. J1, J2 and J4 stay empty, JP1 open because the Grove SHT40 brings its own
Solder the header into the XIAO only and trim the stubs flush. The Wio's edge pads over D0 to D4 carry radio
lines, a pin through both boards ties them to the button, LED, SET and SDA.
U2 LoRa pigtail, U.FL to the SMA bulkhead
never power the radio without its antenna
J6 and CR1 not fitted on Relay
Grove RGB LED, button on a split cable
F1, 1 A resettable fuse from +5V_USB to +5V_F, which feeds J1 and J2. A
shorted cable trips F1 and leaves the USB supply alone.
CR1, Schottky from +5V_IN to +5V_USB, so USB power never flows back
into the Power board. Seeed asks for a diode on any external 5 V into the
R1, R2, 4.7 kΩ I2C pull-ups to 3V3 through JP1. Close JP1 only for a bare
J2 pin 6 RESET stays open, the PMS pulls SET and RESET up inside.
There is no resistor on it.
Grove VCC on J3, J4 and J5 is 3V3. D8 to D10 carry U2's SPI, no
connector uses them. Keep 25 mm clear above U1 for the stack and the
